text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin suffers an injury during
training, so I
bring her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, I'm fine. It's nothing serious, so
don't
worry.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
See, I'm all patched up now, so let's get
right
back to training!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm sure! I can barely feel the
pain
anymore!
choice_data_list_en: Are you really sure you're okay?
Are you really sure you're alright?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And I bet a bit of running will do
wonders for my
mood! I mean, I love
running! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Geez, you're being dramatic. I'm stronger than I look, you know.
choice_data_list: 心配だから、ちゃんと休もう
無理のない範囲でやろう
choice_data_list_en: I'm worried about you, so make sure to get some rest.
Let's do it without overdoing it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ngh. Don't give me that look...
choice_data_list_en: Still, if it gets any worse...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, fine. I'll rest up for today. I
wouldn't want
to worry you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A little disappointed, Ines Fujin returns
to her
dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nice! I knew you'd say yes! Come on,
let's hit the
track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of her light jog, Ines Fujin's
face
crumples up in pain.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. And after I acted all cool back
there.
We might have to call it a day
after all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We cut our training session short, and
Ines Fujin
trudges back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Looks like I should be okay if I
keep the
exercises light.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I'm glad I powered through
training, even
with my injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While monitoring her injury, Ines Fujin
completes
a light training session.
